author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** New polaris-backend/tests/labels_xrpc_live.rs. Spawn labeler server on 127.0.0.1:0. Use proto_blue_ws::frame::MessageFrame::decode + matching header op codes. Three test cases: (1) backfill — seed N labels, connect with cursor=0, assert N frames received in seq order; (2) live fan-out — connect with cursor=current_max, emit one label via LabelEmitter, assert frame arrives within 1s; (3) lagged-consumer — connect, slow-consume, assert server drops the slow connection (or whatever the production design says). Proto-blue check applied: this IS ATProto subscription wire format, so MessageFrame is the right primitive (NOT raw tokio-tungstenite + manual CBOR like #51's original fixture).
